project_type: AWS CDK serverless web application (Python CDK, static frontend)
build_system: Python pip for CDK dependencies, CDK CLI for synthesis
build_command: cd infra && pip install -r requirements.txt && cdk synth
test_command: cd infra && python -c "from stack import HelloWorldNamePrinterStack; from aws_cdk import App; app = App(); HelloWorldNamePrinterStack(app, 'Test'); app.synth()"
verification_instructions: 1. Install CDK dependencies: pip install -r infra/requirements.txt. 2. Run cdk synth from infra/ directory to validate CloudFormation template generation. 3. Verify frontend files exist and are well-formed HTML/CSS/JS.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access available. Python 3.11 and Node.js 22 available. aws-cdk-lib installable via pip.
contribution_requirements: Follow the design.md architecture. Use S3 + CloudFront for static hosting, Lambda for processing, API Gateway for REST API.
key_patterns: CDK stack defined in infra/stack.py, app entry point in infra/app.py. Frontend assets need to be in a separate directory for S3 deployment.
directory_structure: infra/ - CDK infrastructure code (app.py, stack.py, cdk.json, requirements.txt). Frontend assets need to be created (e.g., frontend/ directory). Lambda handler code needs to be created (e.g., lambda/ directory).
